description: A harder version of mixed_life_journey's interleaving test: that scenario switches theme every THREE turns (a clean A-B-C-A-B-C block pattern); this one switches every SINGLE turn (A-B-A-B-A-B). Retrieval has to discriminate theme turn-by-turn with no run of same-theme turns to lean on.

turns.entry: Sent my resume out to three more companies today, feeling the job search grind again.
Grateful for a slow morning with good coffee before the day got busy.
Another interview scheduled for next week from the job search, nervous but hopeful.
Thankful for my friend checking in on me today, it meant a lot.
The interview went well, feels like the job search might finally be turning around.
Another good thing today: finished a book I've been enjoying. Small moments of gratitude keep adding up.
